title_zh: 约定口述采访的匿名和审读边界

scenario.label_zh: 约定口述采访匿名边界
scenario.goal_zh: 明确不披露受访者姓名及可辨认工作地点，并约定发表前交其审读

context_zh: 地方口述历史项目的采访者与受访者商定使用访谈的范围。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: I'll talk about my old job, but I need to remain anonymous in the published interview.

sentences.speaker: Graham
sentences.text: I can give you that assurance. We won't print your name.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: My exact job title and the tiny branch I worked at would identify me too. I don't want to betray my colleagues' trust.

sentences.speaker: Graham
sentences.text: Understood. I'll remove those details as well. Publishing them after this agreement would be a breach of our terms.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: Can I read the edited version before you use it?

sentences.speaker: Graham
sentences.text: Yes. I'll send it for your approval and won't publish it before you agree.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: Then I'm comfortable proceeding on that basis.
